card.map_help: Arrow keys move the map. Plus and minus zoom. 0 resets the view. Enter reads out what is at the centre.
card.zoom_hint: Hold Ctrl or ⌘ and scroll to zoom.
card.info_idle: Select a spot on the map to see what is there.
card.nothing_here: Nothing to show here. Move the map or switch on a layer.
card.load_failed: The map data did not load. Check your connection.
card.outdated: The card was updated. Reload the page to show the map.
card.map_help_tilt: Shift and the arrow keys tilt and turn the map.

editor.title: Title
editor.layers_helper: You can still switch layers on the map. That choice lasts until the page reloads.
editor.show_layer_control_helper: Turn this off to lock the layers, for example on a wall display.
editor.show_location_helper: Puts a pin on the map. The position stays in your browser.
editor.location_mode_home: Your home, from the Home Assistant settings
editor.location_helper: “This device” needs HTTPS and your permission. Without them, the pin marks your home.
